deposits: WITH sampled AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT message_id, status, origination_timestamp, originating_transaction_hash IS NULL AS missing_origination, completion_transaction_hash IS NOT NULL AS has_completion FROM arbitrum_crosslevel_messages WHERE direction='to_l2' ORDER BY message_id DESC LIMIT 10001), windowed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM sampled ORDER BY message_id DESC LIMIT 10000), grouped AS (SELECT status::text AS status, count(*) AS count FROM windowed GROUP BY status) SELECT jsonb_build_object('complete', (SELECT count(*) <= 10000 FROM sampled), 'size', (SELECT count(*) FROM windowed), 'highest_message_id', (SELECT max(message_id) FROM windowed), 'highest_relayed_message_id', (SELECT max(message_id) FROM windowed WHERE status='relayed'), 'oldest_pending_timestamp', (SELECT extract(epoch FROM min(origination_timestamp))::bigint FROM windowed WHERE status<>'relayed'), 'pending_without_timestamp', (SELECT count(*) FROM windowed WHERE status<>'relayed' AND origination_timestamp IS NULL), 'missing_origination', (SELECT count(*) FROM windowed WHERE missing_origination), 'completion_recorded', (SELECT count(*) FROM windowed WHERE has_completion), 'states', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(status, count) FROM grouped), '{}'::jsonb))
withdrawals: WITH sampled AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT message_id, status, origination_timestamp, originating_transaction_hash IS NULL AS missing_origination, completion_transaction_hash IS NOT NULL AS has_completion FROM arbitrum_crosslevel_messages WHERE direction='from_l2' ORDER BY message_id DESC LIMIT 10001), windowed AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM sampled ORDER BY message_id DESC LIMIT 10000), grouped AS (SELECT status::text AS status, count(*) AS count FROM windowed GROUP BY status) SELECT jsonb_build_object('complete', (SELECT count(*) <= 10000 FROM sampled), 'size', (SELECT count(*) FROM windowed), 'highest_message_id', (SELECT max(message_id) FROM windowed), 'highest_relayed_message_id', (SELECT max(message_id) FROM windowed WHERE status='relayed'), 'oldest_pending_timestamp', (SELECT extract(epoch FROM min(origination_timestamp))::bigint FROM windowed WHERE status<>'relayed'), 'pending_without_timestamp', (SELECT count(*) FROM windowed WHERE status<>'relayed' AND origination_timestamp IS NULL), 'missing_origination', (SELECT count(*) FROM windowed WHERE missing_origination), 'completion_recorded', (SELECT count(*) FROM windowed WHERE has_completion), 'states', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_object_agg(status, count) FROM grouped), '{}'::jsonb))
rollup: WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT number, timestamp FROM blocks WHERE consensus ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 1000), classified AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT r.number, r.timestamp, CASE WHEN confirmation.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'confirmed' WHEN commitment.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'sent' WHEN bb.batch_number IS NOT NULL THEN 'sealed' ELSE 'processed' END AS stage, CASE WHEN confirmation.id IS NOT NULL THEN confirmation.status::text WHEN commitment.id IS NOT NULL THEN commitment.status::text ELSE 'not_applicable' END AS parent_finality FROM recent r LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT batch_number, confirmation_id FROM arbitrum_batch_l2_blocks WHERE block_number=r.number LIMIT 1) bb ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT commitment_id FROM arbitrum_l1_batches WHERE number=bb.batch_number LIMIT 1) batch ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, status FROM arbitrum_lifecycle_l1_transactions WHERE id=batch.commitment_id LIMIT 1) commitment ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT id, status FROM arbitrum_lifecycle_l1_transactions WHERE id=bb.confirmation_id LIMIT 1) confirmation ON true), grouped AS (SELECT stage, parent_finality, count(*) AS count, max(number) AS highest_block FROM classified GROUP BY stage, parent_finality) SELECT jsonb_build_object('size', (SELECT count(*) FROM recent), 'lowest_block', (SELECT min(number) FROM recent), 'highest_block', (SELECT max(number) FROM recent), 'latest_block_timestamp', (SELECT extract(epoch FROM timestamp)::bigint FROM recent ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 1), 'states', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(grouped)) FROM grouped), '[]'::jsonb))
published: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_build_object('block_number', b.end_block, 'batch_number', b.number, 'parent_timestamp', extract(epoch FROM t.timestamp)::bigint, 'parent_finality', t.status::text) FROM (SELECT number, end_block, commitment_id FROM arbitrum_l1_batches ORDER BY number DESC LIMIT 1) b JOIN arbitrum_lifecycle_l1_transactions t ON t.id=b.commitment_id), '{}'::jsonb)
confirmed: SELECT COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_build_object('block_number', b.block_number, 'parent_timestamp', extract(epoch FROM t.timestamp)::bigint, 'parent_finality', t.status::text) FROM (SELECT block_number, confirmation_id FROM arbitrum_batch_l2_blocks WHERE confirmation_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY block_number DESC LIMIT 1) b JOIN arbitrum_lifecycle_l1_transactions t ON t.id=b.confirmation_id), '{}'::jsonb)
